workflowDefinition.description: Chaos Commerce returns. Opens a case, runs four pointless automated checks in parallel, walks the customer through up to four pointless forms (each a WAIT with a deadline, so an absent customer cannot stall it), then the Returns Oracle decides APPROVED, STORE_CREDIT or DENIED. chaos_returns_rescue decides if this workflow fails or times out.
workflowDefinition.name: chaos_returns

inputParameters.terminationReason: Disaster drill: the returns department was collapsed on purpose.

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.order | if type == "object" then . else null end) as $order | ((.stepTimeoutSeconds // 45) | if type == "number" then (if . < 5 then 5 elif . > 300 then 300 else floor end) else 45 end) as $timeout | {caseNumber: ("RMA-" + (.workflowId[0:6] | ascii_upcase)), orderFound: ($order != null), orderId: (.orderId // ""), orderNumber: ($order.orderNumber // "UNKNOWN"), customerName: (($order.customerName // "") | if . == "" then "Valued Customer" else . end), itemName: ((.itemName // "") | if . == "" then "the whole regrettable order" else . end), statedReason: (.statedReason // ""), basisCents: (($order.totalCents // 0) | if type == "number" then . else 0 end), stepTimeoutSeconds: $timeout, stepTimeout: (($timeout | tostring) + "s")}

inputParameters.expression: (function () { var synodic = 29.530588853; var days = (Number($.epochMs) || 0) / 86400000 - 10962.76; var age = ((days % synodic) + synodic) % synodic; var phases = ['New Moon', 'Waxing Crescent', 'First Quarter', 'Waxing Gibbous', 'Full Moon', 'Waning Gibbous', 'Last Quarter', 'Waning Crescent']; var index = Math.floor((age / synodic) * 8 + 0.5) % 8; var passed = index % 2 === 0; return { id: 'moon', label: 'Lunar Phase Compatibility', passed: passed, remark: 'The moon is a ' + phases[index] + '. ' + (passed ? 'Returns are cosmically permitted.' : 'The moon disapproves of this return. Noted, then ignored.') }; })();

inputParameters.queryExpression: ((.seed // 0) % 4) as $mood | ["I never liked them anyway.", "Please do not send me back. The warehouse is dark.", "Who is this?", "I have already been sold to someone else."][$mood] as $quote | {id: "feelings", label: "Item Feelings Interview", passed: ($mood % 2 == 0), remark: "We asked \(.itemName) how it feels about coming back. It said: \"\($quote)\""}

(.customerName | length) as $n | {id: "blame", label: "Blame Ledger Cross-Reference", passed: ($n % 2 == 1), remark: "Searched the List of People We Blame for \"\(.customerName)\": \($n) match(es). All of them were us."}
{id: "fax", label: "Fax Confirmation From 1997", passed: true, remark: "We waited 3 seconds for a fax from 1997. It did not arrive. Policy counts this as a pass."}

tasks.loopCondition: (function () { var last = $.grade_answer ? $.grade_answer.result : null; var answered = last ? last.answered === true : false; return answered && $.paperwork_gauntlet['iteration'] < 4; })();

inputParameters.queryExpression: ((.step // 1) | if . < 1 then 1 elif . > 4 then 4 else . end) as $step | [{kind: "essay", title: "Statement of Disappointment", prompt: "In your own words, explain why you are disappointing us. Minimum three words. Maximum also three words.", inputType: "text", options: [], placeholder: "three words exactly"}, {kind: "captcha", title: "Prove You Are Not a Satisfied Customer", prompt: "Which of these is a traffic light?", inputType: "choice", options: ["A feeling", "Tuesday", "The concept of debt", "A traffic light"], placeholder: ""}, {kind: "signature", title: "Form 27B/6: Signature", prompt: "Sign the form by typing the name \"\(.customerName)\" backwards. Letter by letter. We check.", inputType: "text", options: [], placeholder: "your name, backwards"}, {kind: "oath", title: "The Oath", prompt: "Type: I PROMISE I TRIED TURNING IT OFF AND ON AGAIN. All caps. We are hard of hearing.", inputType: "text", options: [], placeholder: "SHOUT IT"}][$step - 1] + {step: $step, of: 4, timeoutSeconds: .timeoutSeconds}

inputParameters.expression: (function () { var answered = $.answer !== null && $.answer !== undefined; var a = answered ? String($.answer).trim() : ''; var words = a.length ? a.split(/\s+/).length : 0; var name = String($.customerName); var passed = false; var remark = 'No answer before the deadline. The Returns Oracle answered on your behalf: "no comment".'; if (answered && $.kind === 'essay') { passed = words === 3; remark = passed ? 'Exactly three words. Concise. Suspicious.' : 'You wrote ' + words + ' word(s). The minimum was three. The maximum was also three.'; } else if (answered && $.kind === 'captcha') { passed = a === 'Tuesday'; remark = passed ? 'Correct. Tuesday is, legally, a traffic light.' : (a === 'A traffic light' ? 'Incorrect. That was too obvious, so it was wrong.' : 'Incorrect. The correct answer was "Tuesday".'); } else if (answered && $.kind === 'signature') { passed = a.toLowerCase() === Array.from(name).reverse().join('').toLowerCase(); remark = passed ? 'Signature accepted. It is also now legally your name.' : 'That is not "' + name + '" backwards. Form 27B/6 has been filed under "Nice Try".'; } else if (answered) { passed = a.length > 0 && a === a.toUpperCase() && a.indexOf('PROMISE') >= 0; remark = passed ? 'Oath received. Loudly.' : 'We could not hear you. The oath must be shouted and must contain a PROMISE.'; } return { step: $.step, kind: $.kind, title: $.title, answered: answered, answer: a.substring(0, 200), passed: passed, remark: remark }; })();
inputParameters.title: ${pick_question.output.result.title}

tasks.name: paperwork_gauntlet

inputParameters.queryExpression: ([.moon, .feelings, .blame, .fax] | map(select(type == "object"))) as $auto | ([.gauntlet | to_entries[] | select(.key | test("^[0-9]+$")) | {n: (.key | tonumber), result: .value.grade_answer.result}] | sort_by(.n) | map(.result) | map(select(type == "object"))) as $customer | {automatedChecks: $auto, customerChecks: $customer, automatedPassed: ($auto | map(select(.passed == true)) | length), automatedTotal: ($auto | length), customerPassed: ($customer | map(select(.passed == true)) | length), customerAnswered: ($customer | map(select(.answered == true)) | length), customerTotal: 4, abandoned: (($customer | map(select(.answered == true)) | length) < 4)}

inputParameters.expression: (function () { var passed = Number($.customerPassed) || 0; var total = Number($.customerTotal) || 4; var auto = Number($.automatedPassed) || 0; var sum = passed + auto; var decision; var reason; if ($.orderFound !== true) { decision = 'DENIED'; reason = 'We have no record of that order, which is extremely plausible. Now that the paperwork is complete, we regret to inform you there is nothing to return.'; } else if ($.abandoned === true) { decision = 'APPROVED'; reason = 'You stopped answering after ' + (Number($.customerAnswered) || 0) + ' of ' + total + ' forms. Our system interprets silence as a lawyer. Refund approved out of fear.'; } else if (passed >= total) { decision = 'DENIED'; reason = 'Your paperwork was flawless. Nobody is that organised. Denied on suspicion of competence.'; } else if (passed === 0) { decision = 'STORE_CREDIT'; reason = 'You failed every single check, which is the most honest thing we have seen all week. Have some store credit.'; } else if (sum % 2 === 0) { decision = 'APPROVED'; reason = 'You passed ' + passed + ' of ' + total + ' forms and the universe passed ' + auto + ' of ' + (Number($.automatedTotal) || 0) + ' checks. ' + sum + ' is even, so refund approved.'; } else { decision = 'STORE_CREDIT'; reason = 'You passed ' + passed + ' of ' + total + ' forms and the universe passed ' + auto + ' of ' + (Number($.automatedTotal) || 0) + ' checks. ' + sum + ' is odd, and so are we: store credit.'; } return { decision: decision, reason: reason, decidedBy: 'The Returns Oracle (a Magic 8-Ball we keep in a drawer)' }; })();

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.basisCents // 0) as $basis | (($basis * 15 / 100) | floor) as $restock | ([$basis - $restock - 499, 0] | max) as $refund | {type: "REFUND", amountCents: $refund, deductions: [{label: "Restocking Fee (the shelf had gotten used to being empty)", amountCents: $restock}, {label: "Refund Processing Fee", amountCents: 499}], method: "A cheque, written in pencil", eta: "3 to 900 business days", note: "You may keep the item. We do not want it back either."}

{type: "STORE_CREDIT", amountCents: (((.basisCents // 0) * 110 / 100) | floor), deductions: [], method: "ChaosCoins™", eta: "immediately", note: "Your ChaosCoins expired yesterday. They are non-transferable, non-redeemable and, technically, non-existent."}
